title: Uniform Electric Field
subject: Physics
description: Analytical particle motion in a uniform electric field.

presets.title: Positive Charge
presets.description: Positive Charge in a uniform electric field.
presets.objective: Relate charge, field and force.
presets.expected: Acceleration follows qE/m; negative charge reverses force.

presets.title: Negative Charge
presets.description: Negative Charge in a uniform electric field.
presets.objective: Relate charge, field and force.
presets.expected: Acceleration follows qE/m; negative charge reverses force.

presets.title: Stronger Electric Field
presets.description: Stronger Electric Field in a uniform electric field.
presets.objective: Relate charge, field and force.
presets.expected: Acceleration follows qE/m; negative charge reverses force.

presets.title: No Electric Field
presets.description: No Electric Field in a uniform electric field.
presets.objective: Relate charge, field and force.
presets.expected: Acceleration follows qE/m; negative charge reverses force.

limitations: Uniform fields; classical nonrelativistic model; no gravity or collisions.

title: Lorentz Force
subject: Physics
description: Nonrelativistic planar particle in uniform E and perpendicular B.

presets.title: Straight Line
presets.description: No electric or magnetic field; retain initial velocity.
presets.objective: Recognize inertial straight-line motion.
presets.expected: Straight line at constant 3 m/s.

presets.title: Electric Only
presets.description: Upward electric field with Bz=0.
presets.objective: Compare electric-only motion with the analytical solution.
presets.expected: Upward acceleration +0.1 m/s²; horizontal velocity stays constant.

presets.title: Positive Magnetic
presets.description: Positive charge moving right with Bz out of screen.
presets.objective: Relate v cross B and charge sign to curvature.
presets.expected: Clockwise circular motion, constant 3 m/s, theoretical radius 3 m.

presets.title: Negative Magnetic
presets.description: Negative charge in the same magnetic field.
presets.objective: Observe curvature reversal at unchanged speed.
presets.expected: Counterclockwise circle at constant speed; radius remains 3 m.

presets.title: Crossed Fields
presets.description: Uniform Ex=Ey=1 N/C and Bz=10 T.
presets.objective: Distinguish electric work from magnetic bending and drift.
presets.expected: Gyromotion superposed on E cross B drift (+0.1, -0.1) m/s.

limitations: Uniform E and Bz; nonrelativistic; no collisions, radiation or space charge.
Synchronized centered Boris/Cayley velocity rotation with trapezoidal position. |qB/m| dt <= 0.02; at most 100000 steps; duration <=20 s.

title: Multi-Zone Electromagnetic Lab
subject: Physics
description: Construct prescribed rectangular fields; local fields superpose and boundaries change acceleration continuously in position and velocity.

presets.title: Single electric region
presets.description: Acceleration only while inside the electric region.
presets.expected: Acceleration only while inside the electric region.
presets.objective: Predict local force, then observe boundary transitions and compare fields.

presets.title: Adjacent opposite electric fields
presets.description: Vertical acceleration changes sign at the shared edge.
presets.expected: Vertical acceleration changes sign at the shared edge.
presets.objective: Predict local force, then observe boundary transitions and compare fields.

presets.title: Electric then magnetic
presets.description: Electric acceleration is followed by magnetic curvature without magnetic work.
presets.expected: Electric acceleration is followed by magnetic curvature without magnetic work.
presets.objective: Predict local force, then observe boundary transitions and compare fields.

presets.title: Adjacent opposite magnetic fields
presets.description: Curvature reverses between magnetic regions.
presets.expected: Curvature reverses between magnetic regions.
presets.objective: Predict local force, then observe boundary transitions and compare fields.

presets.title: Overlapping electric and magnetic fields
presets.description: Electric and magnetic forces act together in the overlap.
presets.expected: Electric and magnetic forces act together in the overlap.
presets.objective: Predict local force, then observe boundary transitions and compare fields.

lesson_capabilities: Create and edit registered rectangular regions
limitations: Prescribed piecewise-uniform fields; no Maxwell solver, collisions or relativity.
Lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive rectangular edges. Zero field outside. Enabled overlaps sum.
Bounded conservative geometry-aware midpoint substeps; finite first-order boundary timing error and corner grazing limitations.

title: Double-Slit Interference
subject: physics / wave optics
description: Coherent scalar Fraunhofer interference with finite-width diffraction envelope and seeded detection events.

presets.title: Wide slit separation
presets.description: Fringes become closer at fixed wavelength and screen distance.
presets.objective: Predict interference spacing and compare the sampled distribution.
presets.expected: Fringes become closer at fixed wavelength and screen distance.

presets.title: Narrow slit separation
presets.description: Fringes become wider.
presets.objective: Predict interference spacing and compare the sampled distribution.
presets.expected: Fringes become wider.

presets.title: Short wavelength
presets.description: Shorter wavelength narrows central fringe spacing.
presets.objective: Predict interference spacing and compare the sampled distribution.
presets.expected: Shorter wavelength narrows central fringe spacing.

presets.title: Long wavelength
presets.description: Longer wavelength widens central fringe spacing.
presets.objective: Predict interference spacing and compare the sampled distribution.
presets.expected: Longer wavelength widens central fringe spacing.

presets.title: Diffraction envelope
presets.description: Finite slit width modulates the interference peaks.
presets.objective: Predict interference spacing and compare the sampled distribution.
presets.expected: Finite slit width modulates the interference peaks.

presets.title: Single-particle accumulation
presets.description: Seeded individual detections accumulate toward the prescribed probability pattern.
presets.objective: Predict interference spacing and compare the sampled distribution.
presets.expected: Seeded individual detections accumulate toward the prescribed probability pattern.

limitations: Coherent monochromatic scalar Fraunhofer model; ideal slits, no polarization or near-field propagation.
Validated (d+a)²/(λL) ≤ 0.1. Screen-angle relation is exact; fringe-spacing label is paraxial.
1001 discrete screen bins and ≤5000 seeded events, conditioned on the observation window; not a full quantum simulation.

title: Kepler's Laws & Orbital Mechanics
subject: physics / orbital mechanics
description: Analytical Newtonian two-body relative motion, bounded Kepler root solving and three-law verification.

presets.title: Circular orbit
presets.description: Constant radius and speed in the circular limit.
presets.objective: Test the three Kepler laws against verified orbital quantities.
presets.expected: Constant radius and speed in the circular limit.

presets.title: Low-eccentricity ellipse
presets.description: The central body is at a focus, not the ellipse center.
presets.objective: Test the three Kepler laws against verified orbital quantities.
presets.expected: The central body is at a focus, not the ellipse center.

presets.title: High-eccentricity ellipse
presets.description: Periapsis speed is much larger than apoapsis speed.
presets.objective: Test the three Kepler laws against verified orbital quantities.
presets.expected: Periapsis speed is much larger than apoapsis speed.

presets.title: Equal-area demonstration
presets.description: Equal elapsed times sweep equal areas despite changing speed.
presets.objective: Test the three Kepler laws against verified orbital quantities.
presets.expected: Equal elapsed times sweep equal areas despite changing speed.

presets.title: Period comparison
presets.description: Increasing semimajor axis increases period according to T²∝a³.
presets.objective: Test the three Kepler laws against verified orbital quantities.
presets.expected: Increasing semimajor axis increases period according to T²∝a³.

presets.title: Periapsis versus apoapsis
presets.description: Compare distance and speed at opposite apsides.
presets.objective: Test the three Kepler laws against verified orbital quantities.
presets.expected: Compare distance and speed at opposite apsides.

limitations: Newtonian isolated point-mass two-body relative orbit; e≤0.9, no relativity or perturbations.
Central-focus view is a relative coordinate frame, not a claim the star is inertially stationary.
Orbital elements are planar; drawn body radii are illustrative, not to scale.

title: Momentum & Collisions
subject: physics / classical mechanics
description: Isolated two-body 1D collisions and frictionless 2D disk impacts with exact time of contact.

presets.title: Equal-mass elastic
presets.description: Equal masses exchange their 1D velocities.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: Equal masses exchange their 1D velocities.

presets.title: Unequal-mass elastic
presets.description: Unequal masses do not simply exchange velocities.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: Unequal masses do not simply exchange velocities.

presets.title: Stationary target
presets.description: An equal-mass stationary target receives the incoming velocity.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: An equal-mass stationary target receives the incoming velocity.

presets.title: Partially inelastic
presets.description: Total momentum remains constant while kinetic energy decreases.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: Total momentum remains constant while kinetic energy decreases.

presets.title: Perfectly inelastic 1D
presets.description: Both bodies share the center-of-mass velocity after contact.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: Both bodies share the center-of-mass velocity after contact.

presets.title: Oblique 2D disks
presets.description: Only the normal relative velocity changes; tangential components persist.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: Only the normal relative velocity changes; tangential components persist.

presets.title: Center-of-mass frame
presets.description: Total display momentum is zero in the center-of-mass frame.
presets.objective: Compare conservation of momentum, energy and normal restitution.
presets.expected: Total display momentum is zero in the center-of-mass frame.

limitations: Exactly two isolated nonrotating bodies; no walls, friction, gravity, simultaneous multi-body contacts or contact deformation.
1D requires zero transverse position and velocity. Initial overlap is rejected.
2D e=0 removes normal relative speed at contact; it does not permanently bind disks.
No collision in the selected time window is reported explicitly; preview evaluates t=0 and includes predicted collision quantities.
